recentItems.title: Tiger Shroff Firing Case: Shooters allegedly TRACKED actor’s schedule for 10 days before firing
recentItems.description:
The Tiger Shroff firing case has revealed shocking details as the police investigate the attack in Mumbai. The shooters allegedly tracked the actor’s movements and schedule for around 10 days and conducted a recce of his home and gym before the incident. Seven rounds were reportedly fired at his car, with five bullets hitting the vehicle and two missing their target. The shooter also allegedly attempted to fire at the actor from close range, but the pistol jammed. The Lawrence Bishnoi gang has reportedly claimed responsibility for the attack. The accused were later arrested at Kota railway station in Rajasthan. Watch for the latest details about the alleged planning, the shooters’ escape route and the ongoing investigation.

recentItems.title: Tiger Shroff Firing: How Skipping Fan Photos May Have Kept the Actor Out of Danger
recentItems.description:

Now, a major detail has emerged from his meeting with Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde. According to a source, Tiger usually takes pictures with fans after his football games, but on Sunday, he decided to skip the photo session because he was tired.
